start.text: The shift is over. I checked every program that started tonight, and the one with the strange name keeps coming back.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. But reporting a program is not the same as stopping it. Let's make our computers harder to trick.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Every defense does two things. [b][color=green]ALWAYS[/color][/b] is what it gives you in any fight. [b][color=red]AGAINST[/color][/b] is what it does to one attack.
B.name: Carla

C.text: So I bring what helps me every day, and what stops tonight's attack.
C.name: Joshua

D.text: Exactly. Use your Security Points, and read what your clues recommended.
D.name: Carla

E.text: Understood. A better defense now means a better night later.
E.name: Joshua
